---
name: Share a sound
about: Offer one of your sounds for the Sounds by others gallery in the app
title: "Sound: "
labels: shared sound
---

**Code:** in Blazbuds, open Sound › Custom, tap the share button on your sound and paste the code here (it starts with BLAZBUDS-EQ:)

**Earbuds:** the model you made it on (like Liberty 4 NC or Galaxy Buds3 Pro)

**What it's for:** one line, like "Clear voices for podcasts" or "Deep bass for the gym"

**Name to show:** your name or a nickname for "By …", or leave empty
